findings.title: Race Condition
findings.untrusted_source: Pipe communication between parent and child
findings.trigger: Child process reads before parent writes
findings.assumptions: The parent process assumes that the child will read after it writes, but there is no synchronization mechanism to ensure this order.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.assumptions: The child process ID is obtained from getppid() and is considered trusted. However, if the child process ID is manipulated, this could lead to unintended consequences.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.assumptions: The pipe file descriptors are trusted, but if they are manipulated, this could lead to unintended consequences.

findings.title: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
findings.assumptions: The signal handler is trusted and does not execute any untrusted code. However, if the signal handler is modified, this could lead to unintended consequences.
